hypothesis: Refusing an unsafe split/line-break locally, while preserving every plausible local geometry dependency, recovers readable prose without recursive rectangle-union or whole-paragraph rejection.
primary_reading_contract: Body must flow at phone width. Only necessary mathematical, figure or uncertain LOCAL atoms may preserve their internal geometry. Full original page is an optional comparison view, never primary reading fallback or success.

arms.A: Local dependency components and local breakpoint refusal
arms.B: Same atoms and proposed relationships, but any local ambiguity locks the containing original native block
arms.C: Frozen PP-S semantic-frame compositor with stencil fix

normalization: Final visible RGB is authoritative. Co-located duplicate native glyph/word aliases and ligature many-to-many source identities must not duplicate visible ink. Logical/paint rectangles locate evidence, never alone grant pixel ownership.
relationships: Geometry-preserving links for overlapping visible ink, script parent candidate sets, detected math/fraction/radical local groups; separate precedence/association links for formula numbers, captions and paragraph continuation. Number-to-formula whitespace is not part of an indivisible object.
failure_conditions: Dependency closure consumes a full paragraph or otherwise prevents that paragraph's ordinary body from wrapping
Mixed target text scale inside a body paragraph
A full original page used as the primary answer
proposed_acceptance: At least85% complete body units genuinely rewrapped at target scale and at least15percentage-point gain over B. Failed/unknown regions stay in the denominator. This is an experiment gate, not a product-wide guarantee.
test_corpus: Six new documents, two adjacent pages each, selected and hash-frozen before algorithm output. Existing30 DocLayNet pilot documents and all known diagnostic paper IDs excluded. Manual reference is QA-only and never passed as algorithm boxes or groups.
execution_order: Original synthetic controls first. Freeze implementation before viewing new source pages for QA. Then run the first registered document pair as an end-to-end demonstration and complete the same frozen12-page batch serially; do not replace failed samples or retune.
resource: One CPU affinity, <=1GiB process group, <=60sec per page including rasterization/encoding/model cost. Reuse installed official dependencies and cached archive directories; no VLM/new model download. Report cold/hot costs separately. Public repository only original code/config/sanitized results and original synthetic fixtures.
verification: Source/320-390-430px20-28px CSS snapshots remain local; those snapshots are not browser proof. Existing permitted sandboxed Chromium CI checks exact renderer with original synthetic fixtures. Android, selectable math and accurate copy/search are not claimed without separate implementation and tests.
